scope: deposited checkpoints; settings read from the checkpoints and code/vae_convlstm, not from an original run log

checkpoint.parameter_count_note: VAE_LSTM as defined in code/vae_convlstm/vae_texas.py (encoder 6,077,488; decoder 8,466,115; quant convs 672; built-in dynamics 13,240). The separately fine-tuned residual ConvLSTM used for rollout has 110,560 more.

data.arrays: data/texas/vae_and_latents_texas (rain_{train,test}.npy fix the row order; state_* and latent_* are rebuilt by generate_states.py and generate_latents.py)

architecture.convlstm_role: predicts the latent increment z[t+1] - z[t] from (z[t], rainfall[t])

inference.protocol: encode the first saved frame, roll the latent forward 191 steps with the residual ConvLSTM, decode all 192 frames; rRMSE and RMSE averaged over storms 101-120, R2 pooled

training.vae_scheduler_note: StepLR(step_size=100, gamma=0.1) is constructed but never stepped (last_epoch 0), so the learning rate stayed at 0.003.
training.vae_epochs_note: The checkpoint is at epoch 1900 with 1900 recorded losses; the script's loop runs to 2000.
training.convlstm_teacher_forcing: probability max(0, 1 - epoch/200) per step, so epochs 200-300 are fully autoregressive
